## World Environment Day

News Date : 05 Jun 2023News ReportMGIT celebrated the World Environment Day on 5th June 2023 with various activities and events. The importance of restoring the natural ecosystems and biodiversity was focused. The day started with a pledge taking ceremony, where 500 students and staff vowed to protect and conserve the environment. A nature walk was organized, where the participants explored and learned about their roles in the conservation of ecosystem. The day also witnessed the conduct of competitions in literary activities like: essay writing, poetry recitation and debate on topics related to environmental issues and solutions. It was a great opportunity to spread awareness and inspire action for a greener and healthier planet.
